body:
Build 0083. Season 8 Episode 1: Before the Count.

Vienna retroactive PRIOR + WITNESS audit complete. Three undisclosed PRIOR sites confirmed:
- A-V13: Augustinerkirche precinct, November 1619, 12 days, 41ft. Habsburg requiem during Bohemian Revolt. FOUND construction — accuracy during the beginning of a long war.
- A-V14: Old University precinct, 1529 First Siege of Vienna, 19 days, 67ft. Information node during military crisis. Compressed-duration presence.
- A-V15: Graben, 1499, 4 days, 23ft. First Vienna visit. Innocent curiosity before the arrangement. Pre-documentation earliest Tyler Vienna record.

Vienna revised total: 15 sites, 587 feet including departure-trace.

Camera Op WITNESS confirmed at all three retroactive Vienna sites — she filmed establishing/transitional shots at each location during S07E05-07 without knowledge of the withheld PRIOR sites.

Tyler on Vienna station platform: the 900-site count is his verified count; actual total unknown. Nine centuries, many places, paid attention before he understood what attention did.

First city of 18 remaining named: Amsterdam. First notation 1628, VOC era. CARDINAL-3 Amsterdam start 1792; all Amsterdam sites PRIOR by definition. Tyler: "I was there for the century."

Lore: TYLER-067 (Footnote #71), Camera Op Entry 60, Jiangshi Memo #047.
title: S08E01 Before the Count — Vienna retroactive PRIOR+WITNESS audit; Amsterdam named
